facts.fact: 裸体营里两人，问“你读过马克思吗”，答“读过，是这些藤椅（留下的红印）”——read Marx 谐音 red marks
facts.anchor: ‘Have you read Marx?’ The other replies, ‘Yes, it’s these wicker chairs.’

facts.fact: 在图书馆大喊要一品脱拉格，被提醒后改成耳语，句子内容不变只是音量变了
facts.anchor: ‘Ah,’ he says, then whispers, ‘A pint of lager please.’

facts.fact: 妻子刚读完《看得见风景的房间》，对方问 Forster？（福斯特），答“不，她自己想读的”——Forster 谐音 forced her
facts.anchor: ‘My wife just read A Room With a View.’ ‘Forster?’ ‘No, she read it of her own accord.’

facts.fact: 对福尔摩斯大喊有案子，他低声说“Lo, a case”（小写字母），我于是用全小写回答——大小写双关
facts.anchor: He looked at me and said ‘Lo, a case.’ ‘i have a mystery for you, mr holmes,’ i replied.

facts.fact: 新同义词词典很烂，而且它也很烂——thesaurus 本应提供同义词，却只重复同一个词
facts.anchor: My new thesaurus is rubbish. Not only that, but it’s also rubbish.

facts.fact: 最喜欢的词是 saliva（唾液）：它从舌头上滚下来——roll off the tongue 双关顺口／流口水
facts.anchor: My favourite word is ‘saliva’. It just rolls off the tongue.

facts.fact: 在读造船的书：riveting，铆接／引人入胜
facts.anchor: I’m reading a book about how ships are built. It’s riveting!

facts.fact: 在写百万字小说，讲一头大毛象在高速左道超车：a mammoth undertaking，庞然大物／艰巨工程
facts.anchor: I’m currently writing a million-word novel about a big hairy elephant passing in the left-hand lane of the motorway. It’s a mammoth undertaking.

facts.fact: 看见白女巫提着公文包，问她做什么，她说 Narnia business——谐音 none of your business
facts.anchor: I saw the White Witch carrying a briefcase and asked her what she was doing. She said, ‘Narnia business.’ I only asked!

facts.fact: 写浪漫哥特小说的恐龙：Brontësaurus，勃朗特三姐妹＋恐龙
facts.anchor: What kind of dinosaur writes romantic, slightly Gothic novels? A Brontësaurus.
